summary: Sandbach United had a tough friendly against St Helens recently, with their opponents' clinical finishing making the difference in a closely contested match. The Ramblers are gearing up for the 26/27 campaign which kicks off in just one week, and they've been busy adding exciting new signings and a returning player to strengthen the squad. With three brand new kits and sponsorship opportunities available, there's plenty of positive momentum heading into the new season.
